## Why it belongs in this package

v0.1 is completed-trajectory remaining useful life (C-MAPSS FD001 and synthetic fixtures). SCANIA and censored fleet labels are v0.2. A user interface, warehouse connector, or extra model family needs a reason beyond the current roadmap.

## What should be reported

If the change touches histories the toolkit cannot score, say whether they are rejected or reported. Silent drops are not accepted.
